What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
 

 
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
 
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
 
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
 
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner 

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
 

 
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
 
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
 
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
 
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

We are looking for an experienced and motivated crane operator to join our team. You will work in a 2-shift system and handle heavy loads safely and efficiently.

Your tasks:

• 
Operate overhead cranes and semi-portal cranes (up to 25 tons)

• 
Perform visual inspections and basic maintenance

• 
Follow safety rules at all times

• 
Work closely with your team to move materials

• 
Keep records of movements and incidents

Your profile:

• 
Experience with cranes, forklifts, or tower cranes

• 
A valid certificate is a plus (can also be obtained internally)

• 
Good technical skills and understanding of safety rules

• 
Willing to work in two shifts (early: 5:00-13:15 / late: 13:15-21:30)

• 
Team player, flexible, precise, and stress-resistant

• 
Good understanding of balance and load distribution

• 
Good Dutch or English skills

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

We are looking for an experienced auto body technician for a company specializing in cars.

What are your tasks?

- You repair and replace damaged bodywork and car parts on vehicles.

- You carry out sheet metal and welding work.

- You will align and assemble parts.

- You will prepare surfaces and ensure a neat finish before spraying, so that the vehicle is safe and aesthetically pleasing again.

Working hours:

Monday to Thursday: 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

What do we expect from you?

- You speak Dutch or English

- You have one year of experience as a bodywork technician or in a garage

- You have your own car (a bicycle is also possible if you live nearby)

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you? 

• You work accurately and contribute to a high-quality end product.
• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!
• The job is mainly done standing up, so you must be physically able to do this.

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

Are you a tech-savvy, handy person?

Can you easily take on a variety of tasks?

Do you also love potatoes?

Then we have the job for you!

We’re looking for a motivated Logistics Operator for a company that specializes in potato processing!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll keep track of the actions taken for inventory management
• You resolve technical malfunctions in the automated cold storage facility
• You assist your coworkers with loading and unloading trucks

What do we expect from you?

• Some familiarity with computers
• No fear of heights
• No aversion to working in a colder environment
• You have a good command of Dutch, English, OR French!
• You will be working in a two-shift rotation or in the night

Is a job as a technician right up your alley?
We’re looking for a motivated and skilled Technician for a leading company specializing in potato product processing!

What will your responsibilities be?

• Ensuring the optimal technical operation of the packaging and production lines
• Performing preventive maintenance on the equipment (minimizing downtime and ensuring efficiency)
• Conducting thorough analyses when malfunctions do occur
• Implementing accurate and sustainable solutions
Thanks to your extensive technical knowledge in the fields of electricity, electronics, PLC controls, and mechanics, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of our advanced equipment. This role offers you a challenging and varied work environment where your expertise makes all the difference.

What do we expect from you?

• You are expected to have a technical background—for example, through an A2 program or a bachelor’s degree—and to have a strong interest in technology.
• You have a solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and electricity, and knowledge of pneumatics is a plus.
• You speak Dutch, English, or French.
• You place great importance on safety, order, and cleanliness, which are central to your work ethic.

We are looking for a glass installer for a leading window and door company in Anzegem. In this role, you will assemble high-quality, durable custom-made aluminum and PVC products.

• You have a technical education or relevant experience in construction
• You work with precision and have a sharp eye for detail
• You think logically to solve problems during installation
• You handle stress well and stay calm when working with fragile glass
• You can work independently and make your own decisions
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• You install various types of glass panels into aluminum windows and doors
• You inspect the quality of the products before they are shipped
• You report directly to the aluminum production manager

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated car body technician who enjoys working with vehicles and is not afraid to get hands-on.

You will join an experienced team in a car body repair company specialized in accident damage repairs.
What will you do?
• Disassemble vehicle body parts 
• Reassemble car components after repairs 
• Work on vehicles damaged in accidents 
• Use basic tools (screws, bolts, removing and reattaching parts) 
What do we expect from you?
• Experience with cars or bodywork is an advantage 
• Strong work ethic and motivation to work 
• Careful and precise approach to tasks 
• A team player with a humble attitude Languages
• No knowledge of Dutch required 
• Basic English is sufficient for communication 
• The team already includes international workers (including Polish and Albanian colleagues)

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

As a production worker early shift, you play a key role in the production process of meat products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities include:

 
• Supplying the production line with meat products.
 
• Trimming and cutting meat where necessary to ensure every product meets quality standards.
 
• No knife experience? No problem! Full training is provided on the job.
 
• Assisting with the loading and unloading of goods.
 
• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client, located in the Kortrijk region, is a global producer of textile machinery.

No two days are exactly the same. As a CNC Turner/Miller, you can expect the following responsibilities:

You set up and operate CNC turning and milling machines with the required precision. Throughout the production process, you monitor the automated machines closely and make adjustments whenever necessary.

Quality is key: you check finished parts and ensure they meet the required standards. You also review measurement results, identify deviations and communicate them to the responsible person.

By monitoring the automatic operation of the production cell, you help prevent downtime and ensure a smooth production flow.

 
• 
You have a strong technical interest and work with precision.

 
• 
You have an eye for quality and detail.

 
• 
You have experience with Fanuc and Mazak systems.

 
• 
You have previous experience in the metal industry as a turner/miller.

 
• 
You enjoy working in a team, while also being able to work independently.

 
• 
You are willing to work in a two-shift system: 5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.

 
• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch, French or English to follow the training successfully.

Are you willing to help us accelerate towards a carbon neutral economy? Are you passionate about energy and do you have the potential to grow with us towards the best energy utility ? Are you an ENGINEER? Then ENGIE, leader of the Energy Transition, wants to meet YOU!
 
ENGIE is committed to promote Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging. We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel.
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
 

Jobomschrijving

• For the operations & maintenace of our power plants or for our renewable operations (wind mills/hydro/batteries), we are mainly looking for industrial and civil engineers in electro-mechanics, mechanics, chemistry, physics or electronics who are fluent either in Dutch/French and English.
• For our engineering firm (Tractebel) we are looking mainly for Dutch speakers with:
• a master in civil engineering and a focus either on infrastructure projects or structural engineering
• a master in engineering with professional experience in road, water and/or civil engineering
• For our sales and energy management teams we are looking for either Dutch/French people with fluency in English and who have power market understanding and good analytical, data and AI skills.

You recognise yourself in the following behaviors:

• genuine care for the safety and wellbeing of yourself and your colleagues
• open & curious to understand other’s perspectives even when your own's are challenged
• ready to prioritise and simplify processes
• able to request and give feedback
• make decisions & deliver results
Research shows that men apply when they met 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. However, we are looking for potential, not perfection. So apply today!

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for a Purchase Order Manager. You will report to the Finance Manager.

This is not a procurement role. Instead, it is a finance-focused position where accounting knowledge, financial controls and process governance are essential.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

• 
Partner closely with Accounting to support accurate financial reporting, month-end close and reconciliation activities.

• 
Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality operations.

• 
Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and business integration projects.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of Purchase-to-Pay processes, financial controls and operational efficiency.

• 
Act as the key contact for Finance Operations, providing expert support to internal stakeholders.

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in accounting, finance, economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
Several years experience in accounting/controlling.

• 
3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

• 
SAP MM/FI, S/4HANA, advanced Excel, and strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

Do you have what it takes to shine as a true forklift hero in the frozen food industry? 

Then we have the perfect challenging position for you! This company, located in Ardooie, is a global player in the development, processing, and marketing of fresh-frozen products such as vegetables, fruit, herbs, and ready-made meals. We need YOU to join our team! 

As a forklift driver working 2 shifts, you'll play a crucial role in our production process. Showcase your talents and embrace the following tasks with pride: 

 
• Confidently and expertly operate the forklift to load, unload, and move goods within the refreshing frozen food environment (-18 degrees Celsius). 
 
• Your precision and care ensure that products are stacked correctly and stored in their designated locations. 
 
• You'll perform warehouse activities with the utmost care, such as counting and checking goods and accurately recording data. 
 

 
• You're a true safety hero and actively contribute to maintaining our high safety standards and promoting a positive work environment. 
 
• You'll collaborate with great colleagues and other departments to ensure smooth production flows. 

Requirements for this adventurous forklift driver role: 

 
• You have a valid forklift certificate OR can demonstrate experience as a forklift driver. 
 

 
• Don't be afraid to brave the cold, as you'll be showcasing your forklift skills in a deep-freeze environment with temperatures down to -18°C. Your forklift cabin is heated! 
 

 
• Your eye for detail and accuracy make you the king/queen of precision work. 
 

 
• You're a true team player and communicate easily with your colleagues. 
 
• You speak fluent English and are willing to learn Dutch. The company offers Dutch lessons before or after your shift.
